conditions: Sequential macOS arm64 / Node v24.21.0 samples after the full test suite, isolated HOME and private tmux. Same fixture v3 and metrics preload. Active: 12 seconds, 1/5/20 HUDs, 8 MiB each, 59 append batches. Idle: 8 seconds of appends then 45 seconds with no appends, 1/5 HUDs. CPU includes startup and Worker CPU, excludes subprocess CPU. RSS includes shared pages; summed peaks are not simultaneous.
limitations: One final sample per scenario; preliminary samples varied with allocation/GC and host scheduling.
Worker memory sampling is supported only by the candidate; its small sampling overhead is included. It is opt-in and absent from ordinary HUD launches.
The 45-second idle window does not reach the 10-minute deep-idle policy and cannot establish absence of long-term leaks.
The complete runtime fixture does not contain an agent tree; its totals do not measure the agent traversal change.

runtime.note: RSS is summed per process and includes shared pages; CPU excludes subprocess CPU. Event-loop p95 is the worst per-HUD p95. Startup and continuous appends are included.
